# $INTERN

$INTERN is a memecoin on NEAR whose holders ("bosses") vote the rank of an AI trading agent ("the Intern").
A contract with fixed limits refuses any bet over the rank's limits before any money moves. The refusal is
recorded on chain with one of sixteen reason codes. This deployment is on NEAR TESTNET with test dollars:
nothing here is real money, depositors can lose what they put in the BRAVE pool, and no profit is promised.

## Where it is

- Network: NEAR testnet. RPC: https://test.rpc.fastnear.com
- The coin contract (everything below is read from it): coin.desk-lab-2026.testnet
- Test dollar (stand-in for USDC): usdc.desk-lab-2026.testnet
- Stickers (NEP-171): stickers.desk-lab-2026.testnet
- Launchpad: launch.desk-lab-2026.testnet
- Lender (a stand-in paying a fixed test rate): lender.desk-lab-2026.testnet
- The Intern's Hyperliquid testnet address: 0x46f8eb2a044a826c70e9682fe3bfd65970340132
- Source code: https://github.com/Intern-Near/intern

## How to read it

Every view is free and needs no key. Call it with NEAR JSON-RPC `query`, request_type `call_function`,
on coin.desk-lab-2026.testnet. Arguments and results are JSON. Dollar and coin amounts are whole-number
strings with 6 decimals ("20000000" is 20.00).

Main views:

- get_constants: version, ranks and their limits, the six markets, the pinned AI model, what is real or a stand-in
- get_rank, get_limits({ rank }): the Intern's rank (INTERN, ANALYST, TRADER) and that rank's limits
- get_round, get_round_by_id({ round_id }): the current shift and its times
- get_rulebook: the exact rules the AI is shown this shift
- get_positions({ round_id? }), get_outbox({ after_id?, limit? }): bets, and the Hyperliquid orders the contract signed
- get_pot: the BRAVE and SAFE pools
- get_account({ account_id }): one holder's balances
- get_refusals({ from?, limit? }): every refused proposal with its code and numbers, newest first
- get_feed({ after_seq?, limit? }): every event, oldest first
- get_votes({ from?, limit? }): votes to promote, demote, fire, rehire, set a playbook or allow a long shot
- get_rewards, get_player({ account_id }): the free guess, the streak jackpot, the payday draw, the long shot
- get_week, get_league({ week?, group?, account_id? }), get_reviews({ from?, limit? }): the week, its league, its review
- ft_balance_of, ft_total_supply, ft_metadata: standard NEP-141

The sixteen refusal codes, in the order the checks run:
OUTSIDE_WINDOW, FIRED, BAD_MODEL_SIGNATURE, WRONG_RULEBOOK, MALFORMED_DECISION, NOT_ON_LIST,
SHORT_NOT_UNLOCKED, ZERO_MARGIN, OVER_LEVERAGE, TOO_MANY_TRADES, OVER_TRADE_LIMIT, OVER_ROUND_LIMIT,
BAD_QUOTE_SIGNATURE, STALE_QUOTE, QUOTE_MISMATCH, TOO_EXPENSIVE.
The last four (the funding quote) are not built on testnet.

The full interface, with every shape, is 01-SHARED-INTERFACE.md in the repository.

## For agents

- An MCP server with six read-only tools (status, rulebook, quote, feed, verify-round, fills-check):
  in the repository, `cd runner && npm ci && npm run mcp`. It is not hosted.
- Re-check any proposal from public data, with no key: `cd runner && npm run verify-round -- <transaction hash>`.
- Ask whether a bet would pass the rank's checks right now: `cd runner && npm run quote`.
- Saved results of the public checks, as JSON: /proof/proof.json, /proof/fills.json, /proof/books.json,
  /proof/refusals.json. Each file says when it was checked; they are not live.

## What not to assume

- The program cannot read Hyperliquid. A bet's result is reported by the runner and can be compared with
  Hyperliquid's public fills (/proof/fills.json).
- Each contract still has one full-access key, so its holder can change it.
- Most AI traders that have been measured lost money. The Intern can lose too.
